props.name: appearance
props.description: vanilla, material, soft, sharp or minimal. Unset renders vanilla. A form passes data.appearance (or the field’s own) through the structure.

props.name: busy
props.description: The host is loading data: days dim and cannot be selected, keyboard focus still moves. Sets aria-busy on the grid.

props.name: colorScheme
props.description: light (default), dark, or auto (follows prefers-color-scheme; for hosts that are themselves dark-aware).

props.name: dayMeta
props.description: Per-day extras keyed by YYYY-MM-DD: { badge?: short text, tone?: neutral | info | success | warning | danger, description?: read with the date by screen readers }. Badge digits are written in the calendar’s numerals. Object or JSON string.

props.name: disableViews
props.description: Turns the month and year views off; the header title becomes plain text. Off by default, because open-ended dates such as birthdates need the views.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Nothing can be selected or navigated; no day is in the tab order.

props.name: disabledDates
props.description: Dates that cannot be chosen: an array or a comma, space or JSON-array string of YYYY-MM-DD.

props.name: disabledWeekdays
props.description: Weekdays that cannot be chosen, 0 Sunday … 6 Saturday: [5, 6], "5,6", "5 6" or "[5,6]".

props.name: enabledDates
props.description: Allow-list. When set (any array, even an empty one) only these dates can be chosen. Null, undefined or an empty string turns it off.

props.name: highlightToday
props.description: Marks today, the current month and the current year visually, in the appearance’s own way. Off by default: today then looks like any other day. aria-current="date" is set on today either way.

props.name: isDateDisabled
props.description: JS property only. (date) => boolean for any other rule; asked only about days no other rule blocked. A throw counts as disabled.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the calendar group (the field label when used in a form). Default: the localized word for calendar.

props.name: language
props.description: en, ar, ku or ru. Sets names, direction, default week start and digits.

props.name: max
props.description: Latest selectable date (inclusive). Navigation stops at its month.

props.name: min
props.description: Earliest selectable date (inclusive). Navigation stops at its month. A min after max makes the range empty (see the notes).

props.name: month
props.description: Month shown in the days view, as YYYY-MM. Settable; clamped to min/max. Opens on the value’s month, else today’s, else the nearest end of the range. Choosing a month or a year in the views moves it.

props.name: numerals
props.description: latn or arab. Default by language: Arabic-Indic digits for ar and ku, Latin for en and ru.

props.name: showToday
props.description: Shows the Today button. On by default. Off removes it; the title and the month buttons stay exactly where they were.

props.name: size
props.description: xs, sm, md (default), lg or xl. Scales cells, type, gaps and default width (300–500px). md equals no size; lg and xl keep a larger minimum width.

props.name: today
props.description: YYYY-MM-DD that stands in for today, through ~lib/clock. Empty: the reader’s local calendar date.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected date as YYYY-MM-DD, or empty. Updated when the user selects a day; a host may set it.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: First column, 0 Sunday … 6 Saturday. Default by language: en and ru Monday, ar and ku Saturday.

methods.name: setFocus
methods.description: Moves focus to the item in the tab order of the current view.

events.name: dateChange
events.description: Detail { value: YYYY-MM-DD }. Fires on every user selection — a day, or the Today button when today is selectable — including re-selecting the current value; never for a disabled day or when a host sets value.

events.name: monthChange
events.description: Detail { month, firstDate, lastDate }. Fires whenever the days view shows another month, except when the host sets month. Use it to load that month’s data.

events.name: viewChange
events.description: Detail { view: days | months | years }. Fires when the view changes. Switching views never changes value.

notes: Takes calendar dates in and gives one out; it makes no requests. A host loads availability on monthChange and passes it back through enabledDates and dayMeta.
Month and weekday names and control labels are bundled for en, ar, ku and ru, so no locale file is fetched.

Rule precedence: range (min/max) → disabledDates → disabledWeekdays → not in enabledDates → isDateDisabled. The first rule that matches is the reason a day is blocked (data-reason on the cell). Rules only ever block: the allow-list never re-enables a day another rule blocked.

Disabled days are focusable but cannot be selected. Inside min/max, the arrow, Home/End and Page keys land on every day of the month, including disabled ones, which carry aria-disabled so a screen-reader user can discover them (the WAI-ARIA APG allows focusable disabled items in composite widgets). Enter and Space do nothing on them. Days of the neighbouring months and days outside min/max are never focused.
A min later than max is an empty range: every day is disabled, the month buttons, Today and the keyboard do not move, and the month stays where it opened unless the host sets month.

Appearance and colour scheme follow .shift form-appearances: every value resolves as --shift-calendar-x, then --shift-x, then the appearance, then the vanilla baseline, so host variables win in light and dark. The component never sets --shift-* itself.

Fonts: Nunito (vanilla, material, soft) or Manrope (sharp, minimal), with Noto Kufi Arabic first for ar and ku — all loaded by the package’s global script. Override with --shift-font-family and --shift-font-family-arabic.

The box never changes size: six rows always, a fixed header band, and the months and years views fill exactly the days view. Only another density (an appearance with a different cell size or gap) or another size resizes it.
Every movement — header roll, day carousel, view slide, year paging — runs on one clock: --shift-calendar-settle (or --shift-settle), 480ms by default; instant under prefers-reduced-motion.
